svg.aria-label: Of 46 hand-entered numbers, 40 are usable and 6 remain open: 31 verified against a primary source, 9 corrected, then verified, 3 plausible, but no primary source exists, 2 not published by anyone, 1 modelled, and labelled as modelled. Coverage of the target job posting is 82%, 14 of 17 requirements evidenced, and the missing ones are named.
svg.desc: Source: data/manual/assumptions.csv and src/gap_analyzer.py, both committed. Coverage is measured against the real job posting in jd.txt.
